Aspen Investment Management Inc decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 11.32% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aspen Investment Management Inc sold 3,460 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.08% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 27,098 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.47M, down from 30,558 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aspen Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $774.39B market cap company.
